name: Multiple boards tabs
description:
- **Request:** Enable desktop mode to open multiple task-manager panels, each pinned to a different board.
- **Root cause:** Kanban store used a single global `activeBoard`, so panels mirrored each other.
- **Store fix:** Added parameterised `boardById`, `sprintBoardChatsFor(boardId)`, `sprintColumnsFor(boardId)` getters and a `kanban.openTaskManager({ boardId })` action.
- **UI fix:** Made `SprintBoardView` board-scoped via a `params` prop, added a "clone" affordance per sprint, and updated `Tab.vue` to show distinct board titles/icons.
- **Wiring:** Registered a new per-board `sprint-board` app (`apps.js`) and mapped `SprintBoardView` in `appComponentsMap.js`, keeping legacy behaviour when no `boardId` is passed.

messages.content: In desktop mode we must be able to open multiple task managers with different boards.
